name: Ghoul

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an Undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

description: Ghouls are ravenous undead that hunt in packs at the edge of graveyards and crypts, their claws carrying a paralyzing rot that lets them feed at leisure.
